content.short: Totally unique, totally awesome Cardano NFT Dolls.
content.description:
Ada Dolls are NFT collectables on the Cardano blockchain inspired by collectable vinyl art toys, and a love of all things graffiti. Season 01 consisted of 2,500 3D rendered male dolls with various hats, clothing, and accessories. So, no matter what your style is, there is an Ada Doll for you.

The first season of Ada Dolls consisted of 2,500 3D rendered male dolls with various hats, clothing, and accessories. So, no matter what your style is, there is an Ada Doll for you. Each Ada Doll is unique and have their own personality.

It’s time to welcome the ladies. Following on from the success of the first season, this time we have 2,500 female dolls. As with S01, they are all unique but don’t be fooled by their cute looks… Some of them may just kick your ass!
